nodes.description: Mapping(address => LockBot) tracking bot lock status, lock start time, initial locked balance and hard-lock flag.
Mapping of reflection-denominated balances used as the canonical ledger of the token.
Nested mapping of ERC20 allowances owner => spender => amount.
Mapping marking addresses exempt from transfer fees.
Total reflection supply, reduced on every fee reflection.
Accumulated token-denominated fees that were reflected.
Tax rate applied to the redistribution/fee portion of a transfer.
Team/marketing tax rate applied on each transfer.
Payable marketing wallet that receives the accumulated ETH and acts as the authorization gate for manualswap/manualsend.
Uniswap V2 router instance used for swaps and liquidity.
Address of the created KANEKI/WETH pair.
Boolean flag indicating that trading has been opened.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by lockTheSwap around router interactions.
Flag enabling automatic contract-token to ETH swaps.
Flag enabling the launch cooldown / max transaction check.
Timestamp when trading was opened, used for the 30 second launch window.
Maximum transaction amount enforced during the launch window.
Constant total token supply (100,000,000,000 * 10**9).
AccessControl role granting permission to manage the bot lock list.
Constant number of days over which a locked bot balance is vested.
Context helper returning msg.sender.
Public ERC20 transfer entrypoint; forwards to internal _transfer.
Public ERC20 approve entrypoint.
Public ERC20 transferFrom entrypoint that also decrements allowance.
Internal _transfer: enforces bot lock rules, launch cooldown, triggers the contract-token swap and then moves balances.
Internal router that dispatches to the standard transfer implementation.
Computes reflection/token amounts, updates _rOwned for both parties and applies fees/team shares.
Credits the team/contract share to the contract's reflection balance.
Reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal to reflect collected fees.
Approves the router and swaps contract tokens for ETH using block.timestamp as deadline.
Sends accumulated ETH to the marketing address via transfer.
Marketing-only function that swaps the entire contract token balance for ETH.
Marketing-only function that forwards the whole contract ETH balance to the fee address.
Owner-only bootstrap: creates the pair, adds liquidity, enables swaps/cooldown and sets max tx.
Locker-only function locking a bot with normal (non hard) lock starting at block.timestamp.
Locker-only function locking a bot with a hard lock starting at block.timestamp.
Locker-only function clearing the lock and hard-lock flags for a bot.
Computes the linearly vested unlocked balance from block.timestamp minus lockedFrom.
Returns initLockedBalance minus the unlocked balance; arithmetic subtraction.
Returns the token balance converted from _rOwned via tokenFromReflection.
Converts a reflection amount into a token amount using _getRate.
Combines token-value and reflection-value computations for a transfer.
Computes fee, team and transfer token amounts from the tax rates.
Converts token amounts into reflection amounts using the current rate.
Computes the reflection supply to token supply ratio, performing a division.
Reads _rTotal/_tTotal and guards against a degenerate ratio.
Owner-only toggle of the cooldown flag.
Owner-only function that resets _maxTxAmount to the full supply.
Internal _approve writing the allowance mapping and emitting Approval.
Empty payable receive hook; accepts ETH from router swaps and can re-enter.
Constructor: sets marketing address, mints the total reflection supply to msg.sender and assigns roles.
Owner-only renouncement of ownership.
Returns the current owner address.
AccessControl role grant guarded by the caller's admin role.
msg.sender: externally controlled caller identity.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time value used for locks, deadlines and cooldowns.
External call to uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with amountOutMin = 0.
External ETH transfer of the whole contract balance to _marketingAddress.
External payable addLiquidityETH call forwarding the contract's entire ETH balance.
External factory call createPair used to set the uniswapV2Pair state variable.
External IERC20 approve on the pair contract with type(uint).max.
Division rSupply.div(tSupply) used as the reflection rate.
Subtraction initLockedBalance - _getBalanceUnlocked(bot) that can revert/underflow.
'from' address parameter of the internal _transfer.
'to' address parameter of the internal _transfer.
'amount' parameter of the internal _transfer.
'bot' address parameter of the bot lock management functions.
'amount' parameter of sendETHToFee.
'tokenAmount' parameter of swapTokensForEth.
'role' bytes32 parameter of the AccessControl role functions.
'account' address parameter of the AccessControl role functions.
Local contractTokenBalance captured before the swap in _transfer.
Local daysPassed computed from block.timestamp - lockedFrom in _getBalanceUnlocked.
Local lockedBalance compared against the post-transfer balance of a locked bot.
Local currentRate derived from _getRate in tokenFromReflection and _takeTeam.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender argument when transfer() calls _transfer.
msg.sender is the owner whose allowance is written in approve().
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom().
_msgSender() supplies the 'from' argument of the internal _transfer.
The constructor mints the whole supply to msg.sender and assigns it both roles.
onlyLocker verifies msg.sender holds LOCKER_ROLE before locking a bot.
onlyLocker verifies msg.sender holds LOCKER_ROLE before hard-locking a bot.
onlyLocker verifies msg.sender holds LOCKER_ROLE before removing a lock.
onlyOwner restricts setCooldownEnabled to the owner (msg.sender).
onlyOwner restricts liftMaxTx to the owner (msg.sender).
onlyOwner restricts openTrading to the owner (msg.sender).
onlyOwner restricts renounceOwnership to the owner (msg.sender).
onlyRole checks the admin role of msg.sender before granting a role.
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _marketingAddress; a weak single-address gate.
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _marketingAddress; a weak single-address gate.
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap swap deadline, a timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is stored as lockedFrom in addToListBotNormal.
block.timestamp is stored as lockedFrom in addToListBotHardLock.
block.timestamp - lockedFrom determines the vested amount in _getBalanceUnlocked.
openTradingTime is set from block.timestamp in openTrading.
The 30 second launch cooldown compares block.timestamp with openTradingTime.
transfer() delegates all logic to the internal _transfer.
approve() delegates to the internal _approve.
transferFrom() invokes _transfer for the balance movement.
transferFrom() calls _approve to decrement the allowance.
_transfer ends by invoking _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer dispatches to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard takes the team share via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard obtains all r/t amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard subtracts/adds the sender and recipient reflection balances.
_takeTeam credits the contract's reflection balance.
_takeTeam obtains the current rate from _getRate.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee accumulates the token fee into _tFeeTotal.
_getValues calls _getTValues for the token amounts.
_getValues calls _getRValues for the reflection amounts.
_getValues reads the current rate from _getRate.
_getRate obtains the supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal for the reflection supply.
_getRate performs rSupply.div(tSupply), an integer division that can truncate to zero.
balanceOf converts reflections via tokenFromReflection.
balanceOf reads the account's _rOwned entry.
tokenFromReflection divides by the rate returned from _getRate.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not already swapping.
swapTokensForEth approves the router to spend the contract tokens.
swapTokensForEth uses uniswapV2Router for the WETH path and the swap.
swapTokensForEth feeds tokenAmount and the path into the external router swap.
The lockTheSwap modifier writes inSwap=false after the external router call returns, leaving a state write after an external call.
sendETHToFee sends the amount to the marketing address.
sendETHToFee performs the external transfer of ETH to _marketingAddress.
manualswap pushes the entire contract balance into an external router swap, enabling reentrancy through the router callback into receive().
manualswap authorization is based solely on equality with _marketingAddress.
manualsend forwards the contract ETH balance through sendETHToFee.
manualsend authorization is based solely on equality with _marketingAddress.
openTrading instantiates and stores the router in uniswapV2Router.
openTrading calls the factory createPair externally to obtain the pair.
openTrading externally adds ETH liquidity using the contract balance.
openTrading externally approves the pair contract with type(uint).max.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading sets _maxTxAmount to 500000000 * 10**9.
openTrading enables swapEnabled.
openTrading stores openTradingTime.
addToListBotNormal writes a LockBot entry into _listBot.
addToListBotHardLock writes a hard-locked LockBot entry into _listBot.
removeLockBot clears the locked and hardLock fields of _listBot.
_getBalanceUnlocked reads the LockBot struct from _listBot.
remainBalanceLocked calls _getBalanceUnlocked to compute the vested amount.
remainBalanceLocked reads initLockedBalance from _listBot.
initLockedBalance - unlockedBalance is an unchecked-style subtraction that can revert on underflow.
_transfer calls remainBalanceLocked to enforce the bot lock requirement.
_transfer reads the bot lock flags from _listBot.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
liftMaxTx resets _maxTxAmount to _tTotal.
The external router swap returns ETH to the contract and invokes the receive() hook, allowing a callback re-entry point.
The 'from' parameter flows through the lock checks and the token transfer in _transfer.
The 'amount' parameter is compared against the locked balance and the max transaction amount.
The 'bot' parameter is the key written into _listBot.
tokenAmount is the amount approved and swapped by the router.
The amount parameter is the ETH value transferred to the marketing address.
daysPassed drives the vesting branch in _getBalanceUnlocked.
currentRate is derived inside _getRate and returned to callers.
contractTokenBalance is captured from balanceOf(address(this)) before the swap in _transfer.
lockedBalance is computed and used in the require check inside _transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'from' parameter has meaning only inside _transfer; fold it into the core _transfer node.
The 'to' parameter is only used inside _transfer; fold it into the core _transfer node.
The 'amount' parameter is only used inside _transfer; fold it into the core _transfer node.
The 'bot' parameter is consumed by addToListBotNormal when writing _listBot; fold it into that core function.
The 'amount' parameter is consumed by sendETHToFee for the ETH transfer; fold it into that core function.
tokenAmount is consumed by swapTokensForEth for approval and swapping; fold it into that core function.
The role parameter is consumed by the AccessControl grantRole check; fold it into that core function.
The account parameter is consumed by the AccessControl grantRole call; fold it into that core function.
contractTokenBalance is a temporary inside _transfer feeding swapTokensForEth; fold it into the core _transfer node.
daysPassed is a temporary inside _getBalanceUnlocked derived from block.timestamp; fold it into that core function.
lockedBalance is a temporary inside _transfer used in the bot require; fold it into the core _transfer node.
currentRate is a temporary produced and returned by _getRate; fold it into that core function.
